summary: Bonner County, ID lookout: 1930 firefinder site, 1935 25-ft pole L-4 tower, one named staffer (1967), destroyed 1969; no current site description found.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1969 per Fire Lookout and Forest Lookouts; no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: one named staff member: Valarie Croopler, 1967

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up; no source describes what remains there now

events.note: 25-foot pole tower with L-4 cab; Newport Miner (July 1935, quoted by Forest Lookouts) reported it under construction at the crest of the range
Valarie Croopler listed as known lookout personnel
Destroyed, per firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: location: six miles north of Oldtown, Kaniksu National Forest
county Bonner; status gone (Forest Fire Lookout Association index)
site developed with a firefinder in 1930

evidence.supports: station almost exactly on the state line, good view to the south and east
evidence.quote: The station is almost exactly on the state line and will command a good view of the surrounding country, especially to the south and east.

notes_for_editor: Brief's status (gone) and 1969 destruction are confirmed by all sources. Added design, 1930 firefinder, 1935 build date, and 1967 staffer. The 25-ft height converts to 7.6 m. Access is not given: the Drive-Up tag is a label, so no access level is recorded. No source describes the site today. The 1935 construction report comes through the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes the Newport Miner; the Newport Miner text was not read directly. Idaho Fire Lookouts' National Archives photo was not added because no image URL was captured.
